2 former Saranac High School athletes appear on college rosters for week ending Sept. 6
Two former Saranac High School athletes appear on college rosters for the week ending Sept. 6. Junior Lia Parker is with Plattsburgh State's women's soccer program, which is scheduled to host Vermont State University Castleton on Sept. 1.
The sport represented is women's soccer, and Plattsburgh State is the listed college team. The team has six scheduled events during the week ending Sept. 6.
Each athlete's college team and scheduled events are listed below.
Former Saranac High School Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Lia Parker
Plattsburgh State women's soccer — SUNYAC
Schedule: Hosts Vermont State University Castleton on September 1 in Plattsburgh, NY; Visits Farmingdale State College on September 5 in Farmingdale, NY; Hosts Stevens on September 6 in Farmingdale, NY
Sydney Myers
Plattsburgh State women's soccer — SUNYAC
Schedule: Hosts Vermont State University Castleton on September 1 in Plattsburgh, NY; Visits Farmingdale State College on September 5 in Farmingdale, NY; Hosts Stevens on September 6 in Farmingdale, NY
